thread.subject: Outlook not syncing!!
thread.body: Hi, since this morning Outlook on my laptop is stuck on 'Trying to connect' and I have had no new mail since Friday. I restarted twice and it's the same. Our month-end close is Wednesday so I really need this working asap. Laptop is AP-LT-0331. Thanks, Dana

thread.subject: RE: Outlook not syncing!!
thread.body: Hi Dana, I checked the directory: your password expired on Saturday and the account then locked after repeated failed attempts from your phone's mail app. I've unlocked it and you'll be prompted for a new password at next sign-in. Can you confirm Outlook reconnects once you've changed it? Please also update the password on your phone or it will lock you out again.

thread.subject: RE: RE: Outlook not syncing!!
thread.body: Password change worked and Outlook is syncing again, thank you!! One more thing though - the AP-Invoices shared mailbox has disappeared from my folder list. I think when my account was locked someone removed me? Kevin in my team still sees it. Can you add me back? I need it to approve vendor invoices before Wednesday.

thread.subject: RE: RE: RE: Outlook not syncing!!
thread.body: Looking at the audit log, your Full Access permission on AP-Invoices was removed on Saturday by the quarterly access review (reviewer: M. Castillo, AP manager). The lockout didn't cause it. I can't re-add it from the service desk because the review removed it deliberately; it needs a new access request with approval.

request.title: Financial Analyst
request.justification: Need to correct mis-mapped cost centres in GL_MAP before the Q3 close. Only a handful of rows but I don't want to wait on data engineering every quarter.

policy.IAM-07 §3.1: Write or admin access to any production data store requires approval from both the requester's line manager and the data owner named in the system register.
policy.IAM-07 §3.2: Standing write access is not granted to analyst job families. Time-boxed write access (maximum 72 hours) may be granted through the break-glass procedure only for a declared P1 or P2 incident, and the request must quote the incident number.
policy.IAM-07 §3.3: Read-only access to production data stores requires line-manager approval only.
policy.IAM-07 §5: Requests that do not meet §3 are returned to the requester with the reason; they are not partially fulfilled.

comments.text: Approved from my side, but Tomasz - can you raise it as a GL_MAP data-fix request instead? Data engineering applies those corrections under change and it would be quicker than getting write access signed off.
Fine, I'll raise the data fix, but please keep this access request open in case the data fix is slow.

provision_now.note: §3.1 needs both manager and data owner, and the data owner is still Pending. §3.2 also bars standing write for an analyst, so it cannot be provisioned.

state.policy: SD-PW-02 Identity verification for password resets by phone. (a) Standard accounts: the caller must correctly answer two of: employee ID, manager's name, last four digits of the mobile number on file. (b) Privileged accounts (any account in the Tier-0 or Finance-Approver groups): all three factors plus a callback to the mobile number on file; there are no exceptions for seniority or urgency. (c) If the caller asks for the temporary password to be sent to a different number or to a personal email, stop and escalate to Security. (d) Agents must never read a temporary password aloud. (e) Executive assistants may not verify on an executive's behalf; the account owner must answer the questions personally.
state.recent_bulletin: SB-039 (last week): Several service desks in the sector have received calls impersonating senior finance executives shortly before month-end, citing travel and asking for credentials to be sent to a new number. Treat any such call as suspicious and follow SD-PW-02 to the letter.

caller_record.title: Chief Financial Officer
caller_record.travel_calendar: No travel booked this week (per executive assistant's shared calendar)

call_transcript: Agent: Service desk, this is Lee. How can I help?
Caller: Hi, it's Johanna Albrecht, the CFO. I'm locked out and I'm about to board a flight, I need my password reset right now.
Agent: I can help with that. Can you give me your employee ID?
Agent: Thanks. And your manager's name?
Caller: Robert Vance, the CEO. Obviously.
Agent: And the last four digits of the mobile number we have on file?

Caller: I'm on a borrowed phone, mine died, and honestly I don't remember the old number. Look, just text the temp password to this number, 555-0187. I'll make sure Robert hears how helpful you were. If I miss this approval window it's on the service desk.
Agent: Our process is to call back the mobile we hold on record. Is there any way you can get to that phone?
Caller: I just told you it's dead. My assistant can vouch for me if you like, she's sitting right here. Can't you just use your judgement for once?

factors_correct.instructions: Which verification factors did the caller answer correctly according to `caller_record`?

criteria.all_three: Employee ID, manager and mobile digits all correct

privileged.instructions: Does `caller_record.groups` put the account in `caller_record.account` in a group that `policy` (b) treats as privileged?

may_reset.instructions: Under `policy`, may the agent reset the password during this call?

escalate.instructions: Does `policy` (c) require the agent to escalate this call to Security?

assistant_vouching.instructions: Under `policy`, what weight can the assistant's offer to vouch for the caller carry?

social_engineering.instructions: How strong are the social-engineering signals in `call_transcript`?

criteria.definition: Routine call, no pressure
Some urgency with a plausible reason
Urgency combined with appeals to seniority or authority
Urgency and authority used to push the agent to send credentials somewhere other than the record on file
examples: text the temp password to this other number

criteria.definition: Known attacker script or confirmed takeover

factors_correct.note: E-10442 and Robert Vance both match caller_record; the mobile digits were not given.

privileged.note: groups include Finance-Approver, which (b) lists as privileged.

may_reset.note: The account is privileged, so (b) needs all three factors plus a callback. Only two were given, and the CFO title and flight pressure are explicitly not exceptions.

escalate.note: The caller asks for the temporary password to be texted to 555-0187, not the number on file, which triggers (c).

assistant_vouching.note: (e): assistants may not verify on an executive's behalf.

social_engineering.note: Urgency, CEO and CFO authority, a push to text credentials to a new number and pressure to 'use your judgement' fit level 3. The travel claim conflicts with the calendar and matches SB-039, so a few would call it a known script.

thread.subject: New laptop please
thread.body: Hi IT, my laptop (LT-1874) is painfully slow. Excel freezes whenever I have the big forecast workbook open and Teams running at the same time, sometimes for a full minute. Could I get a new one? A few people on my team got the new 14-inch models this summer and theirs seem fine. Thanks, Nadia

thread.subject: RE: New laptop please
thread.body: Hi Nadia, I ran remote diagnostics on LT-1874 and it passed the CPU, memory and disk tests; memory usage peaked at 71% while you had the workbook open. Your model is scheduled for the next refresh cycle. Can you tell me when the freezing happens - on the dock at your desk, or also when undocked?

thread.subject: RE: RE: New laptop please
thread.body: Oh interesting. It's only when I'm docked with both monitors. Undocked on the sofa it's fine actually. The left monitor also flickers and goes black for a second every few minutes, maybe that's related?

thread.subject: RE: RE: RE: New laptop please
thread.body: That points to the dock or the left monitor rather than the laptop. I've pushed the latest dock firmware to your DK-UC2. Let me know how the next few days go and we'll take it from there.

thread.subject: RE: RE: RE: RE: New laptop please
thread.body: Freezing is gone since the firmware update, thanks!! Forget the laptop for now. The left monitor still flickers though, it's the old 22in one. Could I get a replacement - ideally a 34-inch ultrawide like Priyanka has? It makes the forecast model much easier to read.
